text.p: Abbott Laboratories Inc. said Wednesday it holds 500,143 shares in SpectRx Inc, or a 6.61 percent stake, now worth about $3.5 million.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Abbott said it bought 143,000 shares of the Norcross, Georgia, drug company on July 7 for $1,001,000.

Abbott acquired most of its stake when it made an equity investment in SpectRx and entered into a collaboration agreement to help develop the company's glucose monitoring, diabetes screening and infant jaundice products.
Abbott, with headquarters in Abbott Park, Ill., said it holds its stake in SpectRx for investment but reserves the right to adopt a range of different plans or proposals .
SpectrRx went public earlier this month with a two million share initial public offering priced at $7 a share.
